image_description: A close-up, slightly low-resolution image of a Rock Beauty fish (Holocanthus tricolor) swimming near a rocky reef background. The fish displays the characteristic black anterior body/head and yellow posterior body/tail coloration. The mouth is dark blue/black, and the eye is visible with a yellow ring. The background consists of textured brown rock and some coral.
